incoming.name: Benjamin Britten
incoming.excerpt: …starting with the woodwind, then the string instruments, the brass instruments and finally the percussion.

outgoing.name: Aluminium
outgoing.excerpt: Horns constructed of stainless steel and aluminium do not sound bad, but are rapidly colonized by microorganisms and become unpleasant to play.

outgoing.name: Bacteria
outgoing.excerpt: These alloys are all biostatic because of the oligodynamic effect, and thus suppress growth of molds, fungi or bacteria.

outgoing.name: Copper
outgoing.excerpt: They have also been constructed from other alloys containing significant amounts of copper or silver.

outgoing.name: Gold
outgoing.excerpt: Some quality instruments use gold plating to prevent corrosion.

outgoing.name: Silver
outgoing.excerpt: They have also been constructed from other alloys containing significant amounts of copper or silver.
